name: @kraftverk/transport-ble
description: Bluetooth LE: the server's radio — BlueZ over D-Bus on Linux, noble elsewhere — the browser's Web Bluetooth and the phone's. Opens the GATT layout a protocol asks for and hands back the bytes; knows no protocol.
